name: Thermoplastic Processes
old_description: With over 75 years of experience, Thermoplastic Processes stands as a premier manufacturer of fabricated and extruded plastics, offering a diverse range including thermoplastic tubing, PVC pipe, and more.
about:
Thermoplastic Processes was founded in 1951 in Georgetown, Delaware. The company operates as a subsidiary of TPI Partners Corporation and has spent over seven decades developing extruded and fabricated plastic products.

The company manufactures a broad line of plastic tubing, rods, pipe, and profiles through extrusion and fabrication processes. Its catalog includes more than 5,000 stock-keeping units across over a dozen material families, such as PVC, polyethylene, polyurethane, nylon, acrylic, polycarbonate, and platinum-cured silicone. Standard items are kept in inventory for immediate shipment, and custom sizes, lengths, and colors are produced to order.

Thermoplastic Processes serves the food and beverage, industrial and chemical, laboratory, and medical sectors, including medical disposables. Its products are used in beverage dispensing, pharmaceutical production, chemical handling, and laboratory fluid transfer, among other applications.

The company positions itself as a cost-effective alternative to branded tubing such as Tygon®, Klearon™, and ClearFLEX™, offering equivalent replacements at lower cost. Its stated mission emphasizes superior service through a dedicated team and a commitment to quality.
